alerts.title: EFV-associated neuropsychiatric effects: insomnia and vivid dreams
alerts.message: Guidelines state EFV frequently causes neuropsychiatric effects, typically insomnia, vivid dreams and dizziness, mostly within the first 2-6 weeks of therapy. Patient has been on EFV since February 2024 (almost two years) yet reports several weeks of poor sleep and vivid dreams, which is a late onset relative to the typical window. Guidelines also list persistent CNS toxicity (insomnia, abnormal dreams) as a reason to substitute. Non-drug causes such as stress or mood disorder should be assessed, and suicidality screening is documented as negative today.

evidence.recommended_action: Assess neuropsychiatric symptoms and mood, including a validated screen (e.g., PHQ-9). If symptoms are persistent or troublesome, consider switching EFV to an alternative agent per local guidelines.
